headline: US futures point to a strong rebound led by Nasdaq and AI-linked names ahead of S&P Global PMI data and a 2-year note auction
raw_text:
- S&P 500 futures (@ES) rise 2.74%, Dow Jones futures (@YM) gain 1.88%, Nasdaq 100 futures (@NQ) advance 3.56%, and Russell 2000 futures (@ER2) add 2.21% as US stocks are set to gap sharply higher.
- Nvidia (NVDA) climbs roughly 9% pre-market after Trump publicly urges NVIDIA’s board to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO, helping lead a rebound in AI-linked names.
- Anthropic (ANT) gains about 4.4% in pre-market trading as growth and technology stocks lead the rebound in futures.
- Abercrombie & Fitch (ANF), Burlington Stores (BURL), and Dick’s Sporting Goods (DKS) are scheduled to report earnings before the bell with notable implied moves indicated.
- Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE), Agilent Technologies (A), and Zoom Video Communications (ZM) are among key companies slated to report earnings after the close.
- S&P Global (SPGI) flash Manufacturing and Services PMI data are due at 9:45 AM ET and are highlighted as the primary scheduled macro releases for the day.
- The US Treasury will hold a 2-year note auction later today, adding to the macro events alongside PMI data.
- Asian equity markets are higher as Japan’s Nikkei (@NKD) futures advance about 3.4%, while European shares are set to open higher as gold futures (@GC) rise and oil (@CL) edges lower.
